difficulty_reason: For locally finitely presented schemes over a locally Noetherian base whose local ring at the base point is a G-ring, the lemma approximates a local algebra map from the local ring of the target into the completion of the local ring of the source, modulo the N-th power of the maximal ideal, by an actual S-morphism from an elementary etale neighbourhood of the source. The proof reduces to the algebra statement about the two completions, produces the morphism through the approximation of the induced map, and then verifies the commutativity modulo the power by comparing the induced maps on completions. Realising the formal data by an honest morphism on an etale neighbourhood is the load-bearing step. Retained author proof at lines 11041-11068.
